description: Climate Change Knowledge Portal: Historical Data is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). This database contains historical temperature and precipitation data aggregated from 2-degree gridded data to the country and basin levels. Coverage: East Asia and the Pacific. It has 2 files in XLS. The portal files it under Climate. The portal gives 2011 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
